description: Curated fact-check evidence knowledge base for NewsLens 3.0

snippets.claim_topic: RBI repo rate monetary policy inflation
snippets.passage: The Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to 6.50% in its February review, focusing on the withdrawal of accommodation to ensure that retail inflation remains within the target.

snippets.claim_topic: India retail inflation CPI target 4 percent
snippets.passage: Under the flexible inflation targeting framework, the government has mandated the Reserve Bank of India to maintain consumer price index (CPI) retail inflation at 4 percent with a tolerance band of 2 percentage points on either side (2% to 6%).

snippets.claim_topic: WHO COVID-19 global emergency ended May 2023
snippets.passage: On 5 May 2023, the World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared with great hope that COVID-19 was no longer a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), transitioning to long-term disease management.

snippets.claim_topic: mRNA vaccines altering human DNA false fact check
snippets.passage: Claims that COVID-19 mRNA vaccines alter human DNA are scientifically false. Messenger RNA from the vaccine never enters the nucleus of the cell where DNA is kept and breaks down shortly after delivering instructions for the spike protein.

OpenAI officially introduced GPT-4 on March 14, 2023, as a large multimodal model capable of accepting image and text inputs and emitting text outputs, demonstrating human-level performance on various professional and academic benchmarks.

snippets.claim_topic: Chandrayaan-3 lunar south pole landing ISRO August 2023
snippets.passage: On August 23, 2023, the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully accomplished a soft landing of the Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander near the south pole of the Moon, making India the fourth country to achieve a soft lunar landing and the first near the south polar region.

snippets.claim_topic: Supreme Court of India electoral bonds scheme unconstitutional
snippets.passage: On February 15, 2024, a unanimous five-judge Constitution bench of the Supreme Court of India struck down the Electoral Bonds Scheme as unconstitutional and violative of the right to information under Article 19(1)(a) of the Constitution.

snippets.claim_topic: ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2023 winners Australia
snippets.passage: Australia won the 2023 ICC Men's Cricket World Cup, defeating host nation India by six wickets in the final played at Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on November 19, 2023, securing their record-extending sixth World Cup title.
